mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% in the prior month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts indicates a sharp contraction in real economic activity, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rising CPIAUCSL signals persistent inflation requiring restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) indicates strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 110 (index 2017=100), it signals a sharp manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines month-over-month.
